responsibility: Implements default-channel character and string I/O as a direct wrapper over TextIO and StdChans. It forwards all reads to the current standard input channel and all writes to the current standard output channel, providing the ISO standard-stream façade for text operations without owning parsing, buffering, or device state.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation half of the STextIO pair: it realizes each declared text I/O routine by passing the standard input/output channels to TextIO, whereas STextIO.def only declares that API.
